metas.name: Vishwanath & Sons
metas.description: A celebrated Olympian shooter travels to America looking for a donor to help his sick child — but unexpected romance complicates his search.

metas.name: Sardar 2
metas.description: When the mysterious Black Dagger threatens national security, Inspector Vijay embarks on his most dangerous mission yet. As the battle unfolds, the extraordinary origin of legendary spy Sardar is finally revealed, uncovering the sacrifices that forged a legend and the secrets that could shape the future.

metas.name: Mandaadi
metas.description: A fishing captain applies his maritime knowledge in a traditional boat race along Tamil Nadu's coast during a festival, leading a six-person team against other crews.

metas.name: Jana Nayagan
metas.description: A clash of ideologies. One stands for the people, the other feeds on control. Their paths collided once before. Years later, a child’s silent fear ignites the past, drawing a former police officer into a battle far bigger than personal revenge.

metas.name: Modha Rathri
metas.description: Two strangers are brought together at an unusual wedding where, in one night, too many surprises unfold and several lies are told, spiraling into chaos that changes everything.

metas.name: Gatta Kusthi 2
metas.description: Picks up after the first film, with Veera and Keerthi balancing parenthood and Keerthi's wrestling career, featuring a role reversal where Veera takes on more domestic responsibilities.

metas.name: DC
metas.description: From avenging his mother’s murder to battling police corruption, Das becomes a fugitive after a deadly heist. Amid a trail of bloodshed and loss, he frees Chandra from a life of exploitation, and she gives him a reason to seek a life beyond violence.

metas.name: Idhayam Murali
metas.description: A young man navigates the complexities of unrequited love, finding that even as years pass and life takes unexpected turns, certain emotions remain deeply embedded in his heart.

metas.name: G.D.N
metas.description: G.D. Naidu overcomes challenges and defies a repressive colonial regime to become one of India's greatest innovators.

metas.name: Captain Dynamite
metas.description: Vishal, an average boy with a boring life gains a particular Superpower after eating a mysterious Noodles called Captain Dynamite

metas.name: Hi :)
metas.description: Two individuals initially exchange a simple "Hi," but through a series of chance encounters, shared experiences, and deep conversations, they gradually develop a strong connection and eventually fall in love.

metas.name: Photographer
metas.description: Photographer follows Veera, a troubled and obsessive photographer determined to prove his worth in a world that has long dismissed him. Driven by ambition and haunted by a painful past, he ventures deep into Mathikettan Solai, a mysterious reserve forest, to capture a rare and elusive natural phenomenon that could change his life forever.

metas.name: Pyaar Prema Kalyanam
metas.description: When a bride refuses to leave her family home after marriage, her husband must find out if he can adjust to life under his in-laws' roof.

metas.name: Ram and Leela
metas.description: A repeatedly unlucky man finally finds the woman of his dreams, only for an unexpected twist to challenge his understanding of love and commitment.

metas.name: Thiraivi
metas.description: A woman is talking to a man about a plan. The man says that he needs to kill someone, but the woman says that he should not do it. The woman is shocked and does not know what to do. Then, the woman was bound and gagged by the man

metas.name: Anbe Diana
metas.description: Set in Perambur, a local Telugu youth falls for an Anglo-Indian girl, sparking a chaotic and humorous clash of cultures between their families.

metas.name: Paris Cafe
metas.description: Olivizhiyaal, from the u.s., dreams of introducing her soulmate kavinSamson, a phd scholar, to the two people she admires most — her parents inIndia. She wants to share a happy news to them. But her smile fades when she learns that her parents, dr. Gautam raja, aSurgeon, and thara, an architect, a fiery social activist, have separated. A buried secret. A shattered trust. A photograph in a paris café that brings thePast crashing back. What did dr. Gautam do? Why did thara, a woman of unshakable ideals, walk away? As oli and kavin dive into the mystery, they uncover a hidden sin, a cry forJustice, and a chance for redemption. A family broken by truth... A daughter determined to heal it. In the end, will forgiveness light the way?

metas.name: Love Oh Love
metas.description: A couple is in love. One partner's excessive spending pushes the other into debt. When the burdened partner decides to seek a divorce, the other files a police complaint through the leader of a women's association. As they begin living together, they gradually understand each other's struggles. Eventually, they reconcile and choose to continue their life together.

metas.name: Nooru Sami
metas.description: Selvi, a widowed mother, devotes her life to raising her two sons in a conservative village. Years later, unfulfilled life comes back into focus, challenging deep-rooted traditions. As family and society strongly oppose change, Selvi must choose between societal expectations and her own happiness.

metas.name: Vengeance
metas.description: Vengeance follows a young woman with a mysterious past that slowly comes to light. Driven by an unrelenting purpose, she transforms into someone capable of crossing any boundary to fulfill her mission. Each obstacle she faces only sharpens her resolve, pulling her deeper into a ruthless path.

metas.name: Habeebi
metas.description: Follows a boy and girl in a Muslim neighbourhood in southern Tamil Nadu whose romance divides their community.

metas.name: Con City
metas.description: Follows a struggling family whose lives change when a receipt printer starts generating money after a lightning strike, leading to public chaos when society discovers the money-making machine.

metas.name: Heartin
metas.description: Fate tosses a couple into an unexpected situation with an ex-girlfriend in the mix.

metas.name: Ego Raman
metas.description: Follows the toxic relationship between a prospective civil servant and a conceited school principal, which intensifies when a Yamaha motorbike enters the narrative.

metas.name: Andharan
metas.description: Karthika's fiancés mysteriously die before marriage. Officer Chezhiyan investigates the deaths and discovers dark secrets from her past, revealing the hidden forces haunting her life as truth and fear collide.

metas.name: Ananya's Call
metas.description: Faced with an impossible encounter in her own home, a young woman must race against time to stop a tragedy that defies the laws of nature.

metas.name: Oviyam
metas.description: A young student navigating school and everyday struggles finds an unexpected source of encouragement through his passion for art and a compassionate teacher.
